<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$templates = array(
    'home'     => '/tmp/templates/home.json',
    'services' => '/tmp/templates/services.json',
    'contact'  => '/tmp/templates/contact.json',
);

$home_id = 0;
foreach ( $templates as $slug => $file ) {
    $raw = file_get_contents( $file );
    if ( false === $raw ) { continue; }
    $tpl = json_decode( $raw, true );
    if ( ! is_array( $tpl ) || empty( $tpl['content'] ) ) { continue; }

    $title = isset( $tpl['title'] ) ? $tpl['title'] : $slug;

    $pid = wp_insert_post( array(
        'post_title'   => $title,
        'post_name'    => $slug,
        'post_status'  => 'publish',
        'post_type'    => 'page',
        'post_content' => '',
    ) );
    if ( ! $pid || is_wp_error( $pid ) ) { continue; }

    update_post_meta( $pid, '_elementor_edit_mode', 'builder' );
    update_post_meta( $pid, '_elementor_template_type', 'page' );
    update_post_meta( $pid, '_elementor_version', defined( 'ELEMENTOR_VERSION' ) ? ELEMENTOR_VERSION : '3.20.0' );
    update_post_meta( $pid, '_elementor_data', wp_slash( json_encode( $tpl['content'] ) ) );

    if ( 'home' === $slug ) { $home_id = $pid; }
}

if ( $home_id ) {
    update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
    update_option( 'page_on_front', $home_id );
    flush_rewrite_rules();
}

echo 'IMPORT_OK home=' . (int) $home_id;
